newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Samsung Eng, 6 other IPOs to trade Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Samsung Eng, 6 other IPOs to trade Tuesday.

text.p: Initial public offerings (IPOs) by Samsung Engineering Co and six others will begin trading on Tuesday, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The seven stocks were initially offered on November 19-20.
Samsung Engineering, a unit of the Samsung Group , will list 1.86 million new shares. The shares were initially offered at a price of 23,000 won per share.
Sindoricoh Co Ltd, an office equipment maker, will list 2.88 million shares. The IPO price was 39,000 won.
Kuk Dong Corp, a textile wholesaler, will list 360,000 shares. The IPO price was 15,000 won.
Kukdong City Gas Co Ltd will list 1.8 million shares. The initial offer price was 22,000 won.
Sewon Chemical Co Ltd will list 442,320 shares. They were initially offered at 18,000 won per share.
Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co Ltd, a chemical products manufacturer, will list 280,000 shares. The IPO price was 15,000 won.
Muhak Alcohol Co Ltd, a distillery, will list 260,000 shares. The initial offer price was 14,000 won.
